Native lesson-03: Write gametes, not whole parental genotypes, on the edges; Count the outcome that was actually asked for; Independent offspring do not compensate for earlier outcomes. These teach gametes, genotype/phenotype probabilities, multiplying specified independent events and expected counts. Original03 does not teach conditional probability or a full addition-rule account.
